literal: Rumour to rise, precious life stands; it, many know not, by good fortune.
translation: My precious life sustains itself because this rumour has risen. By good fortune, the many people who spread it do not know this.
modern: ஊரில் நம்மைப் பற்றிப் பழிச்சொல் எழுவதால்தான் என் அரிய உயிர் நிலைத்து நிற்கிறது. நல்ல வேளையாக, இதை அந்தப் பலரும் அறிய மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: The speaker finds an unexpected comfort in the public rumour about their secret love. The gossip validates their bond and gives them the strength to keep living despite the pain of separation. Ironically, the townspeople spread the rumour to shame them, unaware that they are actually keeping the speaker's hopes and life alive. It is sheer good fortune that the public does not realize the life-saving effect of their gossip.
